product: Leading-edge logic for AI and HPC. 2Q26 net revenue HPC 66% and smartphone 22%; wafer revenue N3 30%, N5 33%, N2 3%, advanced 7nm and below 77% (2026-07-16 IR). Agentic AI revives CPU demand in AI data centers, adding silicon beyond accelerators (2026-07-16 transcript).
demand: Mainly volume plus mix. 2Q26 wafer shipments 4336 kpcs, +16.6% YoY and +3.9% QoQ, while US$ revenue rose 33.7% YoY (2026-07-16 IR), so price and mix also contributed. CEO says TSMC earns value gradually, not via 4x-5x price hikes (2026-07-16). AMD passing on 10% chip price rises signals wafer-cost pass-through (2026-09-21 dailypolitical).
pricing_power: N2 ramp dilutes gross margin 3-4pp; overseas fabs dilute 2-3% early widening to 3-4% later; FX is uncontrolled; price-sensitive end markets are challenged (all 2026-07-16 transcript). Q3 2026 gross margin is guided to 65-67% from 67.7% in 2Q26. A US$60-64B capex year lifts depreciation.
competition: At leading edge, none close. CEO says there is no shortcut and a new leading-edge node takes five to seven years to develop, ramp and qualify (2026-07-16 transcript). At mature nodes Chinese and other low-cost foundries compete, but TSMC is exiting weak commodity segments (2026-07-16). Intel EMIB-T is named as a packaging alternative TSMC welcomes (2026-07-16).
market_strategy: 2026-07-16, CEO C.C. Wei and CFO Wendell Huang: full-year 2026 revenue growth slightly above 40% year over year in US dollars; 2026 capital budget US$60-64B; an additional US$100B Arizona investment; TWD24 cash dividend per share for 2026, up 33%, rising again in 2027; A14 risk production 2027 and volume production 2028.
bull: Q2'26 revenue US$40.20B hit guidance top with 67.7% gross margin; August sales +53.3% YoY support above-40% FY26 growth; six of seven 90d analyst actions are raises, packaging is the binding AI constraint.
bear: Q3 gross margin guided down to 65-67% on N2 ramp and overseas fabs; only 10-20% of US$60-64B capex goes to the tight packaging bottleneck; 21-session momentum is context only, and target levels are perverse.
falsifier: 2026-10-15 Q3 gross margin below 65% (guidance floor) or Q3 revenue below US$44.6B, or a cut to the US$60-64B 2026 capex.

Last 30d: 2026-09-10 August revenue NT$514.8B +53.3% YoY (TSMC IR); 2026-09-21 Kaohsiung packaging park groundbreaking (Reuters via dailypolitical); 2026-09-22 Erste Group lifted FY26 EPS to 16.78 (tickerreport). Separately, N2 ramp dilutes gross margin 3-4pp, guiding Q3 to 65-67% (2026-07-16).
web_demand_product: Leading-edge logic for AI and HPC. 2Q26 net revenue HPC 66% and smartphone 22%; wafer revenue N3 30%, N5 33%, N2 3%, advanced 7nm and below 77% (2026-07-16 IR). Agentic AI revives CPU demand in AI data centers, adding silicon beyond accelerators (2026-07-16 transcript).
web_price_volume_mix: Mainly volume plus mix. 2Q26 wafer shipments 4336 kpcs, +16.6% YoY and +3.9% QoQ, while US$ revenue rose 33.7% YoY (2026-07-16 IR), so price and mix also contributed. web_bottleneck: Advanced packaging. CEO C.C. Wei: our packaging capacity is so tight that now it limits my customers growth (2026-07-16 transcript). Management says tool capacity is not a constraint, but packaging plus test gates AI accelerator output, not wafer capacity.
web_who_benefits_next: Packaging, test and equipment suppliers: the TSMC-anchored Kaohsiung packaging park broke ground 2026-09-21, and ASML gains on EUV and High-NA (2026-07-16 transcript). Taiwan supply chain benefits (Taiex record intraday high 2026-09-22). AI customers Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom receive scarce leading-edge and packaging capacity.
web_who_loses: Foundry rivals Samsung Foundry and Intel Foundry lose leading-edge share as TSMC holds about 72.5% of the foundry market (Barchart 2026-09-22 context). Mature-node commodity players lose as TSMC exits weak commodity segments (2026-07-16 transcript). Customers absorb rising wafer costs, as AMD passing on 10% chip price rises shows (2026-09-21).

web_ceo_promised: 2026-07-16, CEO C.C. Wei and CFO Wendell Huang: full-year 2026 revenue growth slightly above 40% year over year in US dollars; 2026 capital budget US$60-64B; an additional US$100B Arizona investment; TWD24 cash dividend per share for 2026, up 33%, rising again in 2027; A14 risk production 2027 and volume production 2028.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far. 2026-07-16: 2Q26 revenue US$40.20B hit the high end of the US$39.0-40.2B guidance and gross margin 67.7% beat the 65.5-67.5% guidance. 2Q26 capex US$15.70B versus 1Q26 US$11.10B confirms the step-up. 2026-09-10 August sales NT$514.8B, +53.3% YoY, consistent with above-40% growth.
web_what_would_falsify: 2026-10-15: Q3 2026 gross margin below 65% (guidance floor) or Q3 revenue below US$44.6B. Or 2026-10-08: September monthly revenue with YoY growth below 30% (August was +53.3%). Or any cut to the US$60-64B 2026 capex, or to the above-40% full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance.
